Episode 247. Liberation War of Laprarosa (17)
A sudden surge of black energy erupted from one side of the transparent wall of the passage right after Jin spoke.
It was Spirit Energy. Jin and Murakan quickly swung their swords and wings to push back the exploded energy, but were engulfed in an odd sense of unease.
[Kid, this…]
[It's not Rokia's Spirit Energy, Murakan.]
[Right, isn't it? Darn, who could it be? There's no way someone else who uses Spirit Energy could have invaded here without us knowing.]
Indeed, it was impossible for any enemy to sneak into the rift without Jin noticing, given the Plutonian Domination Swords energy that covered the battlefield.
Even Rokia, a possible suspect, was bound by Jin himself.
[A witch's Spirit Energy? Hmm, but it seems too impure for that, not very threatening either. Even the small fry related to Spirit Energy have better purity than this.]
[Maybe that's why it's more likely to be the witch's. Or perhaps, it's the faded spirit energy of Solderet.]
[What? Solderet?]
A thought suddenly struck Jin.
Maybe the Spirit Energy that just emerged from within the dimensional wall was the spirit energy Solderet used to move the Plutonians into this space.
[It could be the residue left when the witch interfered with Solderet's attempt to save the Plutonians. Sribi, Masalrun, Karmashu. This energy doesn't even remotely resemble those three.]
[Hmm, now that you mention it, that's possible. If so, the dimension itself might have been created by the witch, not Solderet.]
[That makes sense.]
Solderet and the witch, Heluram.

Jin did not fully understand the relationship between these two transcendents. He only knew for sure that there's a commonality between spirit energy and Spirit Energy, and at their extreme, they exhibit nearly similar properties.
Throughout his trials and events after his return, Jin had felt that they had some special connection.
[Murakan, do you remember anything more about Solderet, the witch, and Rokia?]
Murakan shook his head.
[Nothing. You saw my last moment in Keitam's painting. I don't even know how I found the witch in the Black Sea... But Rokia's new face did seem oddly familiar.]
The face of Rokia they saw this time was completely different from a thousand years ago.
[I also felt it was familiar. Now that I think about it, it resembles Temar.]

[Ah, right! Why did that guy have a face resembling Temar? With his current powers, he could maintain his own appearance. He could even look younger than Talaris. And it wasn't exactly Temar, just a resemblance. What a weird taste.]
[...Temar's descendant. Could it be his child's face?]
Murakan halted in his tracks.
[What...? A child?]

Murakan was shocked. Even after the defeat in the war a thousand years ago, Temar's lineage had continued without interruption, but he had never considered that. The thought that Temar might have had a child.
[Oh, it makes sense. Who, who did he have it with!? He liked so many women... Oh man, it couldn't be Rokia, could it?]
[Do you think that's possible? It's a rather dreadful story.]

[No, no. If we consider the atmosphere at that time, Ruet is the most likely. Everyone thought Ruet's unrequited love would eventually bear fruit. But Luiet remained trapped at his grave... Who, then…]
Murakan's eyes widened as if something dawned on him.
[Lucy... Lucy Runkandel. After the war, the child born between Temar and Lucy continued the lineage.]
Lucy Runkandel.
She was the last of the Ten Knights Jin had never encountered in reality or records.
[...If Rokia's face we saw this time really is the child of Temar and Lady Lucy. Rokia might have been using him from then until now.]
After liberating Laprarosa, the truth about Rokia needed to be discovered, given the clues already found about Rokia's true form and hiding place.
Murakan seemed greatly shocked, alternating between the names Temar and Lucy.
[These people... how could they not tell me? How could they not let me know?]
[The situation of the family was grim back then. Besides, it's not certain yet.]
[No, I'm sure of it. I feel betrayed! I wanted to have a nephew too! Hey, kid. If you and the historian ever get married and have kids, you better tell me…]
[Suddenly what nonsense, it's noisy. Let's hurry, we still have a mountain of things to do after rescuing the brothers of Laprarosa.]
Having eradicated the Red Plutonian as a single force, there was still Ziffle, Kinzelo, the Sun God Religion, Ganesto, and perhaps transcendent beings like the witch.
They all had to be eliminated. To do so, the power of the brothers, especially Ban's safety, was crucial.
If every war ends this arduously, they couldn't keep up with the enemies' pace. The enemies could be plotting, or trying something special unknown to Jin.
The dimensional storm was growing more intense.

Murakan formed a thick shield with his spirit energy, and Jin kept rotating the energy of the Plutonian Domination Sword. Without Ban's energy helping to push back the dimensional storm, even they would not have been able to move at this speed.
The ordeal Jin and Murakan were facing now was akin to a beginner without any equipment attempting to climb a steep snow mountain.
Neither of them had ever traversed such a space before, and the impact of the dimensional storm made their previous battles seem trivial in comparison.

Jin and Murakan regulated their breathing while deciphering Ban's energy flow. Jin was also conserving his strength, needing to maintain the Plutonian Domination Sword properly in case of any unforeseen events.
The walls continued to crumble more frequently. Still, murky and crude Spirit Energy poured out, and occasionally, there were clear signs of energy left by Rokia.

It was the witch's pool, remnants of the curse Rokia left behind. The curse heading towards Laprarosa had been torn apart by Ban's Plutonian Domination Sword and embedded throughout the passage like crystals.
It meant they were getting closer to the energy flow caused by Ban.
[Brothers! Can you hear me?]
Jin shouted. His voice, shattered by the dimensional storm, could not carry far, but Jin kept calling out to his brothers.
With each step, Murakan's shield became more distorted.
[The pressure of the energy flow seems to be increasing rapidly as we get closer to Laprarosa. It must be several times stronger inside.]
Jin was beginning to worry a bit.
He was also grateful that they came to investigate. If they had just waited outside for the liberation device to activate, Ban and the brothers would have had to endure this pain alone.
[Brothers, I am here!]
How much time had passed?
Time in this space often flowed differently than in the real world. Perhaps hours had already passed, or only a few seconds inside Laprarosa.
Just as Jin was about to call out to his brothers again.
Suddenly, the energy flow from Ban that had been stretching far away began to rapidly subside.
[Damn it! Could it be?]
In just 2 or 3 seconds as Murakan shouted, Ban's energy flow completely disappeared. Jin did not respond but heightened his senses.
‘…Ban's Plutonian Domination Sword has not been deactivated!’
Ban's vast energy had not vanished but had converged rapidly into a single object.
Jin determined it was a sword. And there was only one reason for the entirety of the Plutonian Domination Sword's energy to wrap around a blade.
[Murakan, we need to dodge! Dodge now!]
[Right! Dodging!]
Jin and Murakan split to the sides, each enveloping themselves in a protective shield.
A moment later, a piercing blue flash flew right where they had been standing. It was a blade energy that would have been fatal even for Jin and Murakan, especially within this dimensional storm.

It was natural, considering it was the final chapter of the Plutonian Domination Sword condensed into a single strike. The blue trajectory left by the sword energy caused the dimensional rift to crumble.
And the two realized the blade energy contained Spirit Energy. It was a powerful Spirit Energy that they hadn't even seen when directly confronting Rokia outside the Great Desert.
[Spirit Energy...! Tell me Ban has not fallen into corruption.]
There was no need for Jin to answer.
The Spirit Energy in the Plutonian Domination Sword was there because Ban had been binding the curse until now. And Ban shooting the blade energy now was to pave the way for them.
"Jin Brother! Is it really you, Jin Brother!?"
A familiar voice called out.
It was Tantel, the brother who always came to greet Jin as a guide whenever he visited Laprarosa.
[Brother Tantel!]
Tantel looked emaciated as if he would collapse any moment, covered in black wounds stained with Spirit Energy.
[Are you alright!? The other brothers...?]
"Just a bit hurt but safe, so don't worry and come in quick!  Brother Ban said she couldn't maintain the passage for long!"
As Tantel finished speaking, Jin and Murakan had already reached his side. They had just entered the giant rift from which he had emerged.
The rift was about to close. If it closed now, Jin would enter Laprarosa having lost all the energy of the Plutonian Domination Sword.
[Kid! I'll hold it open a bit longer, so quickly recover your energy!]
Fortunately, Jin was not alone in this place. Murakan spread his pair of wings and poured spirit energy into the rift.
[I did well to bring you, Murakan.]
Jin closed his eyes and concentrated. His energy flow quickly poured into the rift.
Once the Plutonian Domination Sword's energy was fully recovered, Murakan, gasping for breath, nodded.
[Know this and don't bother me when I go back to play with strawberry pie.]
The rift closed. Jin supported the collapsing Tantel and looked ahead.
The landscape of Laprarosa, the homeland of the brothers, unfolded before them.
